description: This file defines the ClearEntityCaches class, which implements an operation for clearing all caches of a specified entity delegator within the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework. It includes validation, execution logic, and a factory class for instantiating the operation.

classes.name: ClearEntityCaches
classes.description: Implements an operation to clear all caches in an entity delegator as defined by the <clear-entity-caches> XML element.

classes.name: ClearEntityCachesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ClearEntityCaches, keyed by the element name 'clear-entity-caches'.

methods.name: ClearEntityCaches
methods.description: Constructor that validates the element attributes and child elements, initializing the operation.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the cache clearing operation using the delegator obtained from the context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ClearEntityCaches object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the element name associated with this operation.
